groups.activity: The War Within, then Chains of Harrow
conditions: After The War Within, speak to Onkko in Cetus to begin Chains of Harrow.
Cephalon Simaris sells a repeatable main blueprint for 50,000 standing, but the quest gives the first one.
Harrow Neuroptics is on Spy Rotation A, not C: a successful three-vault run earns a roll immediately.
Run Pago solo if possible; a quick clean vault run is faster and safer than relying on public squads.
The Chassis is a per-kill drop, not a mission reward. Only Void Fissure Corrupted enemies count.
Farm while opening relics so the Chassis hunt also produces Prime rewards and Void Traces.
bonuses: Atlas with Ore Gaze is a community-recommended option for extra eligible-enemy drops.

conditions: Defection follows A-A-B-C: one rotation is two rescued squads, so the first C reward is after 8 squads.
All Defection tiers use the same Systems rates. Choose a comfortable node; difficulty does not improve the drop chance.
Cleared waves determine the reward. Do not abandon a run just because a defector dies.
bonuses: Volt or Wisp speeds defectors and is the most useful quality-of-life pick. Bring batteries and watch the route ahead for Eximus units.
Oberon, Trinity, Nezha, or a crowd-control Nova help if the defectors are dying.

disclosures.title: the painful part is optional
disclosures.body: Taveuni, Kuva Fortress Survival gives both Neuroptics and Systems at 12% on Rotation C (20 minutes), along with Kuva. It is slower per Systems roll than Defection but avoids its buggy escort mode.

groups.activity: choose Harrow during his weekly offering
conditions: This is an alternative to the quest and all three farms: the offered frame's rewards are guaranteed rather than random.
The current week is not authored here because the rotation changes; confirm Harrow is offered before committing.
bonuses: Circuit removes Defection RNG entirely, but claiming Harrow before Chains of Harrow skips the quest's natural reward path.

conditions: Farm the 2,000 Kuva before the final build; Taveuni is a convenient source if using the Survival alternative.
bonuses: The three component builds run in parallel.
